caption: The drawing depicts a lidded vessel with two symmetrical handles, rendered in shades of grey pencil on a light, off-white background. The body of the vessel has a cylindrical shape that expands outward slightly at the base, and is decorated with embossed or engraved arch-like patterns. The base and the rim both feature a band of evenly spaced circular elements resembling beading. The lid of the vessel is dome-shaped, topped with a finial that comprises a central stem with spherical elements and ornate detailing. The handles, attached on each side, are elaborately curved with a scroll-like design, extending outward from the upper sides of the vessel before curving back in toward the body. The composition centers the vessel on the page, with soft shading used to suggest depth, volume, and reflective surfaces. The drawing is bordered by faint lines and shows some light discoloration or wear around the outer edges of the paper.
title: Pewter Sugar Bowl
